notes.title: The nightmare is almost ready… 🕯️👥
notes.notes:
[p]Darkness spreads through the asylum. For months, we’ve been working in silence, building every brick of fear — and it is time to reveal what has been accomplished.[/p][p]Here is what now lurks in the shadows:[/p][list][*][p]A [b]fully functional first-person controller[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]haunting environment[/b]: corridors, dormitories, laboratories, morgues, and the basement, all ready to explore.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Locked doors and keys[/b], forcing you to search, backtrack, and lose yourself deeper in the maze.[/p][/*][*][p]A terrifying [b]monster with 3D model, patrol routes, animations (idle, walk, run, attack), and AI logic[/b] — hunting you if you make noise or use your flashlight.[/p][/*][*][p][b]HUD and menus[/b]: main menu, settings, language selection, key bindings, and mouse sensitivity adjustment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fear detection via webcam[/b]: the monster reacts to your emotions, your expressions, your screams.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Score system & top 10 leaderboard[/b], letting you challenge yourself and others.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Teaser trailer (2:32)[/b] with dynamic camera shots to capture the atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p]Continuous [b]performance improvements and bug fixes[/b], to make the nightmare smooth… and deadly.[/p][/*][/list][p]The game is almost finished. Only one thing remains:
➡️ [b]Optimizing the 4-player co-op mode[/b].[/p][p]Soon, you will no longer be alone. Four survivors, trapped in the same labyrinth. Four lights piercing the dark. Four hearts beating faster and faster, as the monster comes closer.[/p][p]Once this last step is complete, the game will go online.
The nightmare will no longer be just yours — it will be shared.[/p][p]Prepare yourselves. Fear is coming.[/p]

notes.title: Thank you for 1,000 wishlists… and this is just the beginning.
notes.notes:
[p]It’s official: over 1,000 of you have added [i]Don’t Scream Coop[/i] to your wishlist.
For a solo, indie, terrifying passion project… that’s huge.[/p][p]I’m building [i]Don’t Scream Coop[/i] piece by piece:
🎮 real cooperative gameplay
👹 a creature that hunts you intelligently
🔦 a flashlight you should think twice before using…
And an oppressive world where your fear gives you away.[/p][p]🚧 [b]What’s next?[/b]
Development continues actively, including:[/p][list][*][p]A full visual and sound jumpscare system[/p][/*][*][p]Smarter light-based enemy detection[/p][/*][*][p]A complex, non-linear map design[/p][/*][*][p]And soon… a playable demo (stay tuned 👀)[/p][/*][/list][p]💀 [b]How you can help:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Share the game with friends who love horror co-op[/p][/*][*][p]Wishlist it if you haven’t yet (we’re aiming higher!)[/p][/*][*][p]And most importantly: [b]don’t turn off your mic…[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for your support.
You are the light in this dark corridor.[/p][p]— Pierre, solo dev of [i]Don’t Scream Coop[/i][/p]

notes.title: Dev Blog #2
notes.notes:
[p]Here’s a new update on the development of [i]Don't Scream Coop[/i], our cooperative horror game in first-person view. We’ve made a lot of progress since the last post — let’s break it down:[/p][p]✅ [b]What’s already in place:[/b]
🎮 Functional FPS player: camera, movement, smooth view, visible body.
🔦 Flashlight integrated into the player’s hand, toggleable, with realistic range.
🚪 Interactive door system: some doors can be opened, others are locked; they rotate properly and block movement.
👤 Monster imported: it’s in-game, moves, chases the player when detected, and can kill on contact.
🧠 Basic monster AI: automatic patrols, pursuit triggered by proximity or noise.
🏚️ Main map: colliders fixed, smooth player navigation.
💡 Manual lighting setup: unwanted lighting removed (directional light/skybox), dark and controlled atmosphere.[/p][p]⚙️ [b]Currently in progress:[/b]
🏚️ Main map: design in progress.
💀 Monster AI improvements: to make it more unpredictable and terrifying.
🖥️ Interaction detection system: doors, lights, objects, noise — all will have consequences soon.[/p][p]🔜 [b]Coming very soon:[/b]
🤝 Multiplayer co-op mode: testing on current scene with player sync, voice and light.
🎬 Official teaser editing (exact length: 2 min 32), with custom soundtrack.
🧯 Flickering light zones for extra tension.
🗣️ Microphone integration: making noise will put you at risk. Silence is safety…
📸 Webcam mode prep: to track your fear.[/p][p]Thanks to everyone following and supporting the project!
We’re building a truly cooperative horror experience, where fear comes from what you see — and what you say.[/p][p]🖤 Add it to your wishlist.[/p][quote][p]And remember: scream, and you die.[/p][/quote][p]— The [i]Don’t Scream Coop[/i] Team[/p]

notes.title: Something is taking shape… and it’s not human.
notes.notes:
[quote][p]Every night, the forest grows.
Every line of code adds a heartbeat.
And now… [b]it’s here[/b].[/p][p]The core of [i]Don't Scream Coop[/i] is starting to pulse.
This is no longer a prototype. No longer a flashlight test in an empty hallway.
This is a game — a real one — breathing fear and tension with every step.[/p][p]Here’s what we’ve built so far, and what’s lurking in the dark:[/p][/quote][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 [b]GAME SYSTEMS:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🎮 [b]Full first-person view[/b]: You play with [b]visible arms[/b], [b]hand animations[/b], and even [b]visible torso and feet[/b] when looking down.[/p][/*][*][p]🔦 [b]Flashlight system[/b]: A visible, realistic flashlight you carry in your hand. It lights the way… but also draws attention.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 [b]Playable coop[/b]: Multiplayer is now working. You enter together. You scream together. Sometimes… you die together.[/p][/*][*][p]🧠 [b]Monster AI[/b]: The entity reacts to [b]sound[/b], [b]light[/b], and [b]proximity[/b]. If you breathe too loudly through your mic… it hears you.[/p][/*][*][p]👁️ [b]Animated 3D monster model[/b]: We’ve replaced the placeholder with a humanoid creature inspired by [b]Japanese horror folklore[/b]. Its movement is unnatural — because it is.[/p][/*][*][p]🗺️ [b]First playable level[/b]: A functional exploration zone, with patrol paths, fear mechanics, and dynamic ambient audio.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧪 [b]CURRENTLY IN TESTING:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🎙️ [b]Microphone integration[/b]: The game listens. Screaming (or speaking too loudly) will get you killed.[/p][/*][*][p]🎥 [b]Optional webcam mode[/b]: Your facial reactions may eventually influence the game. Being watched is already a form of fear.[/p][/*][*][p]⚙️ [b]Horror balance[/b]: We’re testing several variants of the monster’s behavior to balance tension and replayability.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔮 [b]COMING SOON:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]📽️ First official trailer[/p][/*][*][p]🧠 Second monster prototype (we’re thinking about it…)[/p][/*][*][p]🕯️ Randomized events (light failures, footsteps, hallucinations…)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][quote][p]Silence may be your only weapon.[/p][p]In [i]Don't Scream Coop[/i], silence can save your life…[/p][p]🧟 [b]Add the game to your wishlist[/b] to be among the first to enter.[/p][p]Just remember: it’s not the scream that kills you…
…it’s what hears it.[/p][/quote]
